extracted.name: Brunch Spinach Salad
extracted.description: This brunch salad is simple to prep with baby spinach, fruit, pine nuts, and poppy seed dressing for a colorful, crowd-pleasing addition to the table.
instruction_lines: Place spinach in a large bowl. Arrange bananas, strawberries, mandarin oranges, cranberries, and pine nuts on top.
Toss with poppy seed dressing before serving.
